put_cherry_bowl.selection_reason: A compact right-arm grasp-and-place task; the HDF5 instruction, not the misleading directory suffix, identifies the destination as the glass.
put_cherry_bowl.left_role_reason: Across every episode the left joints/gripper stay near their inactive chart while the high-view review shows the right arm moving the cherry; the glass is supported by the table.

stack_tomato_cans.selection_reason: Adds placement with a height/contact constraint rather than another unconstrained receptacle drop.
stack_tomato_cans.left_role_reason: Every episode places the right can with the right arm while the destination can remains table-supported; no left-arm hold or cooperative handoff is present.

draw_triangle.selection_reason: Adds sustained surface contact and a structured multi-segment trajectory with substantially longer episodes.
draw_triangle.left_role_reason: All episode-level left-arm activity is near-static and the complete-episode contact sheet shows only the right arm holding the pen against the fixed whiteboard.

wipe_glass_water.selection_reason: Adds free-form contact/coverage motion plus an explicit return-to-table phase.
wipe_glass_water.left_role_reason: The right arm alone picks, wipes, and returns the sponge in every reviewed episode; the glass/table supplies the physical support and no left-arm brace is required.

press_stapler.selection_reason: Adds a non-grasp force/contact behavior and balances the longer trajectory tasks with a concise press action.
press_stapler.left_role_reason: The stapler is table-supported and every episode shows a right-arm-only downward press; left-arm motion is not required to stabilize or actuate it.

grab_stick_into_bottle.selection_reason: Provides the required insertion/precision family with a narrow target opening.
grab_stick_into_bottle.left_role_reason: All reviewed episodes use the right arm to insert the stick into a bottle that remains upright on the table; no left-arm bottle support or cooperative alignment is present.

shake_glass.selection_reason: Adds repeated rotations and a long-horizon return phase that differs from drawing and wiping trajectories.
shake_glass.left_role_reason: The right arm alone lifts, rotates, and replaces the goblet throughout all episodes; the left arm never provides required support or a handoff.

pour_water_can2cup.selection_reason: Adds orientation-sensitive pouring and a return phase while keeping the receiving cup externally supported.
pour_water_can2cup.left_role_reason: The right arm handles the can in every episode while the cup remains on the table; no left-arm cup stabilization or collaborative pour is used.
